name: cloudflare-mcp-pro
title: Cloudflare MCP Pro
description: MCP server that exposes the Cloudflare REST API v4 (DNS, Zones, Workers, KV, R2, D1, Pages, Cache, WAF, Analytics) in a single local stdio server authenticated by API token.
features: Zones: management, settings (SSL/TLS/HTTPS), cache purge, GraphQL analytics
Workers: deploy, routes, secrets, cron triggers
KV, R2, D1 (SQL), Pages, Queues, Tunnels
Security: WAF rulesets, IP access rules, page rules, SSL packs, custom hostnames, Turnstile
Email Routing, Logpush jobs, Workers AI inference
Human-approval gate: mutating tools require confirm:true, else return a redacted preview
Single API-token auth with shared retry and rate-limit handling
